name: Barrow Hill: Curse of the Ancient Circle

locations.note: Stranded at the petrol station on the autumn equinox, the player explores the stone circle, the barrow, the holy well and the swamp of Barrow Hill with a PDA, a GPS and a metal detector.
The Barrow Hill stone circle is Duloe's circle, which the designer visited many times while dreaming the game up.
St Anneka's Well is St Cuby's Well below Duloe, the first sacred well the designer found; a second well near Sandplace lent its steps and ferns.
